visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a wooden bedside table with a woven lattice top. A hand reaches out from the left and presses the top of a black twin-bell alarm clock to silence it. Soft morning light enters the room. (2) A wide shot shows a bedroom where a woman is under white duvet covers. She quickly sits up and stretches her arms high above her head. (3) In a bathroom setting, the woman stands in front of a mirror wearing a grey sweater, yawning widely with her mouth open. (4) The woman is seen brushing her teeth vigorously over a sink with various toiletries on a shelf behind her. (5) In a room with a white wardrobe, she hops on one leg while struggling to pull up grey sweatpants. (6) She stands before an open closet, holding a blue cardigan on one hanger and a white jacket on another, appearing to decide between them. (7) In a kitchen area, she holds a smartphone to her ear with one hand while pouring orange juice from a carton into a blue mug. She is now wearing the blue cardigan. (8) At the entryway, she puts on black high-heeled shoes, looks around frantically as if she's forgotten something, and then rushes through a doorway covered by a floral curtain. (9) She returns to the room to quickly change from grey pants into black trousers before finally grabbing her bag and exiting through the front door.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, rhythmic, metallic ringing of a twin-bell mechanical alarm clock. The sound is dry and piercing. (2) A hard cut silences the alarm, followed by a sudden burst of high-tempo, energetic swing-pop music featuring bright brass stabs and a driving drum beat. (3) A female vocal yawn is heard briefly over the BGM as the music maintains a steady 124 BPM. (4) Rhythmic scrubbing sounds (toothbrushing) and fabric rustling are layered over the continuous jazz-influenced pop track. (5) A brief, muffled female voice speaks as if on a phone, exhibiting an excited but hurried tone. (6) Liquid pouring sounds and a metallic door latch click are clearly audible between the musical beats. (7) The music reaches a crescendo with a brass flourish and ends abruptly with a final percussive hit.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Montage of Clichés -> Abrupt Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic parody of the stereotypical opening routines found in early 2000s teen movies. It uses fast-paced editing and specific cinematic text overlays to mock the 'clumsy but busy' protagonist trope.
